Quick Manual

The Quick Manual includes abridged information from full [Help Pages](https://opendental.com/site/helpfeature.html).

Pages with information for third-party integrations are also included. Existing customers should instead use the more extensive Help Feature built into Open Dental. Quick Manual pages are intended for use by potential customers or third-parties who may not have access to the [Help Feature](https://opendental.com/site/helpfeature.html).

The Quick Manual is organized by category and can be accessed using the Table of Contents or by using the search. Categories include:

- [Modules](https://opendental.com/site/0_modules.html)
  - [Appointments Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_appointments.html)
  - [Family Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_family.html)
  - [Account Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_account.html)
  - [Treatment Plan Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_treatmentplan.html)
  - [Chart Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_chart.html)
  - [Imaging Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_images.html)
  - [Manage Module](https://opendental.com/site/0_manage.html)
- Main Menu
  - [Setup](https://opendental.com/site/0_setup.html)
    - [Program Links](https://opendental.com/site/programlinks.html)
  - Lists
  - [Reports](https://opendental.com/site/0_reports.html)
  - eServices Setup
- Toolbar
  - [eServices](https://opendental.com/site/eservices.html)

Note: Information on third-party services is not abridged and is stored in the Quick Manual for public access.
